# KEYSTONE PLUMBING SUPPLY, LLC
## TERMS AND CONDITIONS OF SALE

**As published June 2025**

---

### 1. ENTIRE AGREEMENT

These Terms and Conditions of Sale, together with Keystone Plumbing Supply's Privacy Policy (collectively the "Terms"), establish the complete agreement between Keystone Plumbing Supply, LLC, a Virginia limited liability company ("Seller"), and Buyer, and govern all transactions between the parties unless modified by written agreement signed by both Seller and Buyer. Any prior negotiations, agreements, or terms contained in Buyer's purchase order that differ from or supplement these Terms shall have no effect unless expressly accepted in writing by an authorized representative of Seller.

### 2. SHIPMENT

All orders are shipped FCA, Seller's facility (Incoterms® 2020). Title to and risk of loss for all goods transfer to Buyer upon delivery to Buyer, Buyer's designated representative, or the carrier selected for transportation. Buyer shall bear all costs associated with special packaging or handling necessitated by Buyer's specifications or instructions. Should Buyer request or cause a delay in shipment, or should Seller ship an order based on inaccurate, incomplete, or misleading information provided by Buyer or Buyer's agents, Buyer shall be responsible for all storage expenses, additional costs incurred, and assumption of risk during such delay.

### 3. PRICE

Seller reserves the right to adjust prices at any time unless a price is specifically confirmed in Seller's written quotation. Buyer will be charged at the price in effect on the date of shipment. All quoted prices exclude sales taxes, excise taxes, tariffs, duties, transportation charges, and other applicable levies. Buyer shall pay any applicable sales, excise, use, or similar taxes in addition to the purchase price, unless Buyer furnishes Seller with a valid, executed certificate of tax exemption.

### 4. DELIVERY

Seller shall endeavor in good faith to meet Buyer's requested delivery schedule. Should delivery be delayed solely due to Seller's actions, Seller shall pay for expedited shipping to fulfill the order. Seller shall not be liable for failure to perform caused by circumstances beyond its reasonable control, including acts of God, war, labor actions, civil disturbances, accidents, pandemics, material unavailability, carrier delays, supplier delays, or similar occurrences.

### 5. CANCELLATION

Buyer shall not cancel or modify any order except with Seller's prior written authorization and upon payment of all applicable cancellation and restocking charges determined by Seller.

### 6. PAYMENT

Payment for all goods shall be due Net 10th Prox from the date appearing on Seller's invoice. Should payment not be received by the due date, Seller may declare Buyer's entire account balance immediately due and payable without notice or further demand. All overdue amounts shall accrue a monthly service charge of up to one and one-half percent (1.5%). Buyer may not withhold, offset, or condition payment on any basis other than Seller's performance. Third-party payments received by Buyer do not relieve Buyer's payment obligations to Seller. Buyer's credit application with Seller is incorporated into these terms.

### 7. LIENS

To the extent payment is received by Seller without retention, Seller warrants there are no liens on the furnished work or the products. Seller shall execute mutually agreed and appropriate lien waivers upon request of Buyer; provided that Seller shall have no obligation to provide lien waivers, release of claims or other documents from its suppliers and/or subcontractors. Any lien waivers shall be conditioned upon full payment to Seller by Buyer. Seller does not relinquish any statutory lien and/or bond rights; such rights are only relinquished to the extent payment is actually received without retention. Any provision in a lien waiver that waives rights beyond payment shall be null and void.

### 8. INSPECTION AND ACCEPTANCE

Buyer must inspect all goods promptly upon receipt and before use or installation. Any claims regarding damage, shortages, delivery errors, or improper delivery must be communicated to Seller in writing within two (2) business days following delivery. Failure to submit a written claim within this period shall constitute acceptance of the goods, and Buyer forfeits all rights to reject the goods or revoke acceptance. Claims for billing discrepancies or invoice adjustments must be submitted in writing within ten (10) business days of the invoice date. Any claims not timely received in writing shall be waived.

### 9. RETURNS

Within 30 days of purchase, Buyer may return stocked goods that are not custom or special order items, provided that: (i) the goods remain in new, unused, and uninstalled condition, in undamaged original packaging with all components included; and (ii) the goods have not been used, installed, modified, rebuilt, reconditioned, repaired, altered, or damaged in any manner. All returns shall be subject to a restocking charge unless Seller agrees otherwise in writing. Custom and special order goods may be returned only if the manufacturer consents to the return, and Buyer shall reimburse Seller for any restocking fees, cancellation charges, or other costs imposed by the manufacturer.

### 10. COMPLIANCE WITH EXPORT CONTROL LAWS

Buyer warrants that it is not subject to United States ("U.S."), European Union ("E.U."), or United Nations ("U.N.") sanctions, including, but not limited to, being identified on the U.S. Specially Designated Nationals ("SDN") List, or more than 50 percent owned by an SDN. Buyer further acknowledges that products are subject to U.S. export control laws and regulations and cannot be exported, reexported, or transferred except in compliance with such laws and regulations. If Seller delivers products to Buyer within the U.S., Buyer expressly assumes any and all duties and liability associated with subsequent export of the products, including but not limited to determining export licensing requirements, obtaining all required authorizations, and submitting Electronic Export Information, if required. Seller shall not be named the U.S. Principal Party in Interest (USPPI) in any export transaction without Seller's prior express approval. If Buyer is located out of the U.S. and Seller delivers products to Buyer's U.S. Authorized Agent, the export shall be routed. Seller shall not be responsible for submitting Electronic Export Information, if required. Buyers located outside of the U.S. expressly assume all duties and liability associated with obtaining a U.S. Authorized Agent to file Electronic Export Information. Buyer expressly assumes responsibility for determining export licensing requirements under the Export Administration Regulations and obtaining authorization for the export as may be required. Seller shall not serve as Buyer's U.S. Authorized Agent. Seller has the right to request information regarding Buyer's U.S. Authorized Agent, such as the data elements filed in the Automated Commercial Environment, the Internal Transaction Number, the date of export, and the filer name.

### 11. WARRANTIES

**(a) Keystone Private Label Goods:** Seller warrants good title to private label goods and, for a period of twelve (12) months following delivery to Buyer, that such goods shall conform to their published specifications and shall be free from defects in material and workmanship. Buyer's sole and exclusive remedy for breach of these warranties shall be repair or replacement of the defective goods at Seller's cost, or refund of the purchase price if the goods are returned during the warranty period.

**(b) All Other Goods:** Seller warrants only that it possesses good title to all goods sold. All other warranties are limited to those provided directly by the manufacturer. Seller shall assign manufacturer warranties to Buyer and shall assist Buyer in pursuing repair, replacement, or other remedies for warranty claims made within the manufacturer's warranty period.

**(c) Installation Warranty:** For those products installed by Seller, if any, for a period of twelve (12) months from installation or first use (whichever occurs later, but in no event longer than eighteen (18) months from date of installation), Seller warrants that services shall be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner and in accordance with manufacturer's installation instructions and local code requirements. Upon receipt of notice from Buyer that installation services were not performed in accordance with the limited warranty herein, Seller shall re-perform the services to the Buyer's satisfaction. The foregoing shall not apply if there is evidence of abuse or misuse by Buyer or any third party.

**(d) Services:** Seller warrants that services shall be performed in a professional and competent manner by qualified personnel.

**(e) Warranty Exclusions:** The foregoing warranties do not apply to goods damaged by misuse, accident, modification, inadequate physical or operating conditions, improper maintenance, incorrect storage, or faulty installation. SELLER DISCLAIMS ALL OTHER EXPRESS AND IMPLIED WARRANTIES, INCLUDING WITHOUT LIMITATION ANY IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY OR FITNESS FOR ANY PARTICULAR USE OR PURPOSE, WHETHER OR NOT SELLER HAD KNOWLEDGE OF SUCH PURPOSE. SELLER MAKES NO WARRANTY THAT PRODUCTS OR SERVICES WILL COMPLY WITH ANY APPLICABLE LAWS, ORDINANCES, REGULATIONS, CODES, OR STANDARDS, INCLUDING REGULATIONS REGARDING LEAD CONTENT OR LEAD-FREE STANDARDS, EXCEPT AS SPECIFICALLY SET FORTH IN A WRITTEN AGREEMENT SIGNED BY SELLER'S AUTHORIZED REPRESENTATIVE.

### 12. INDEMNIFICATION

Each party ("Indemnifying Party") shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless the other party and its officers, directors, employees, and agents ("Indemnified Party") from any claim, suit, action, arbitration/mediation proceeding, or demand for damages to property, bodily injury, death, intellectual property infringement, or any liability, cost, fines, penalties, or expense, including reasonable attorneys' fees ("Loss"), to the extent such Loss results directly from the negligence, willful misconduct, or intentional act or omission of the Indemnifying Party. This indemnification obligation shall not apply to Loss proximately caused by the negligence or conduct of the Indemnified Party.

### 13. INSURANCE

Seller shall maintain all insurance coverage required by law and shall not permit such coverage to lapse. Seller shall carry Workers' Compensation insurance as mandated by applicable state law, commercial general liability insurance with minimum limits of two million dollars ($2,000,000) per occurrence and four million dollars ($4,000,000) in the aggregate (including product liability), and automobile liability insurance with minimum limits of five million dollars ($5,000,000). These coverages may be provided through primary policies, umbrella policies, or any combination thereof. Upon Buyer's request, Seller shall provide a Certificate of Insurance evidencing compliance with these requirements and naming Buyer as an "Additional Insured" on a primary and non-contributory basis, utilizing endorsements equivalent to CG2010 04/13 and CG2037 04/13. Seller shall not be obligated to pay any premiums or fees for Owner Controlled Insurance Program ("OCIP") or Contractor Controlled Insurance Program ("CCIP") type insurance programs. Performance and payment bonds shall not be required unless expressly specified in Seller's quotation.

### 14. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY

IN NO EVENT SHALL SELLER BE LIABLE FOR SPECIAL, INCIDENTAL, CONSEQUENTIAL, PUNITIVE, LIQUIDATED, STATUTORY, OR INDIRECT DAMAGES, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO LOST PROFITS, REVENUES, CAPITAL INVESTMENT, BUSINESS OPPORTUNITIES, OR BUSINESS INTERRUPTION COSTS, ARISING FROM THE SALE OF GOODS AND/OR SERVICES. THIS LIMITATION OF LIABILITY APPLIES REGARDLESS OF WHETHER THE CLAIMED DAMAGES RESULT FROM BREACH OF CONTRACT, BREACH OF WARRANTY, TORT, STRICT LIABILITY, OR ANY OTHER LEGAL THEORY.

### 15. U.S. GOVERNMENT CONTRACTS

If Buyer is procuring, directly or indirectly, for sale to or on behalf of any agency of the U.S. Government, and/or the Buyer's prime contract is funded in whole or in part by U.S. Government federal procurement funding or the end customer is the U.S. Government, Buyer agrees that (a) All products provided by Seller meet the definition of a "commercial product", specifically a "commercially-available-off-the-shelf (COTS) item", and/or all services provided by Seller meet the definition of a "commercial service" as those terms are defined in Federal Acquisition Regulation ("FAR") Part 2.101; and (b) All products and/or services are provided by Seller on a firm-fixed-price basis, and governed by FAR Part 12 and its implementing regulations. Seller agrees to the incorporation of mandatory flow-down clauses aligned with the value of the products, those FAR and Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement ("DFARS") clauses applicable to COTS products, and those clauses that apply to the specific products and/or services provided under these Terms, including but not limited to FAR 52.244-6, FAR 52.212(e), and DFARS 252.244-7000. Clauses that are not applicable by their terms are self-deleting and not applicable under these Terms. With regard to any Made in America Law, including the Buy American Act, Buy America Act, Trade Agreements Act, or any other domestic preference requirements that may otherwise be applicable, a product's country of origin is unknown unless otherwise specifically stated by Seller in writing and prepared in connection with such order. If the reasonableness of a product's price cannot be established, if cost or pricing data is required for any other reason, or if the products and/or services cannot be considered "commercial", Seller may cancel its acceptance of the applicable order without liability. The version of any applicable FAR or DFARS clause listed in this Section 15 shall be the one in effect on the date of sale.

### 16. SEVERABILITY

These Terms and Conditions of Sale shall be interpreted as though drafted jointly by both parties, and any ambiguity or uncertainty shall not be construed against either party. Should any provision be determined by a court of competent jurisdiction to be unenforceable, such provision shall be modified to the minimum extent necessary to render it enforceable, or if impossible to modify, shall be severed from these terms without affecting the enforceability or validity of the remaining provisions.

### 17. NON-WAIVER

The failure of Seller in exercising any right or enforcing any provision of these Terms and Conditions of Sale shall not constitute a waiver of such right or provision, nor shall it affect the right to enforce that provision or any other provision in the future. No waiver of these terms shall be valid or binding unless made in writing and signed by an authorized representative of Seller.

### 18. DISPUTE RESOLUTION

The parties shall attempt in good faith to resolve any dispute arising from or relating to these Terms and Conditions of Sale through prompt negotiation between senior executives with settlement authority. Such executives shall hold a position at a level above the personnel with day-to-day responsibility for administering these terms. Should negotiation fail to resolve the dispute, either party may pursue legal remedies as provided in Section 19.

### 19. GOVERNING LAW

For products and/or services delivered within the U.S., all disputes related to or arising out of Buyer's order shall be governed by the laws of the jurisdiction in which the goods are delivered, without regard to conflicts of law principles. For products and/or services delivered outside of the United States, all disputes related to or arising out of Buyer's order shall be governed by the laws of the Commonwealth of Virginia, without regard to conflicts of law principles. Any legal action or proceeding arising from or related to these terms or any transaction shall be brought exclusively in the state or federal courts located in such jurisdiction. Each party hereby consents to the jurisdiction and venue of such courts and waives any objection to venue or claim of inconvenience. The United Nations Convention on Contracts for the International Sale of Goods shall not apply to these terms or any transaction.
